💬 Iran calls on southern neighbours to block US attacks

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran warnS its southern neighbours to immediately prevent the US from using their territory for attacks on Iranian soil, saying its retaliatory strikes on the US bases are lawful self-defence under Article 51 of the UN Charter.

In a statement released on Thursday, Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned the "colonial and arrogant" U.S. policy of violating state sovereignty by stationing military bases and forces on foreign territory. It said countries, particularly Iran's southern neighbours, bear a clear responsibility to stop Washington from using their land, waters and airspace to prepare and launch attacks against the Islamic Republic.
​
"Iran's defensive strikes against military bases, facilities and assets used for aggression against Iran are in accordance with Iran's legal and inherent right to self-defence under international law and Article 51 of the United Nations Charter," the ministry said.
​
It called on the neighbouring countries of the southern Persian Gulf to "immediately prevent the aggressors from using their facilities and territorial, maritime and airspace domains for aggression against Iran, in order to halt the continuation and spread of the flames of war in the region." It warned against allowing a "sinister American-Zionist plot to create enmity and mistrust among the countries of the region" to succeed.
​
The ministry stressed that Iran "has no hostility or enmity toward any of its neighbours or the countries of the region" and said it firmly believes the only path to lasting security is "understanding and cooperation among the countries of the region, free from the military presence and destructive and malevolent interventions of America."

Today, Vova is known all over the world. His videos consistently generate hundreds of millions of views, his content gets recognized by the biggest names in the industry, and people on the level of Joe Rogan and Arnold Schwarzenegger follow his media.

The new regulations are expected to come into force within a year.

📌 Mempools: Where Transactions Wait Before the Block

Main Points
⏺ A mempool is the waiting room for unconfirmed transactions
⏺ Bots, validators, and network actors can see pending activity there
⏺ This post explains why mempools matter for fees, speed, and MEV

1️⃣ What It Is — after you send a transaction, it usually waits before being included in a block.
2️⃣ Why Gas Matters — higher fees increase the chance your transaction gets picked faster.
3️⃣ Where Risk Lives — public mempools let bots see your trade before it executes and try to profit from it.
4️⃣ User Impact — delays, speeding up transactions, cancellations, sandwich attacks, and sudden fee spikes.
5️⃣ Practical Rule — check fees, avoid excessive slippage, and use protected routes for large swaps.
Final Thoughts

A mempool is the blockchain waiting room. But in that room, your transaction is visible not only to validators — also to actors trying to profit from its order.
